subject.title: [Bug]: Webchat MEDIA: attachments fail with "Attachment unavailable" in password auth mode — assistantAttachmentAuthToken never populated by server

question: Should password-mode Control UI media requests reuse an existing browser session/token contract, or is explicit propagation of a media credential to the bootstrap configuration an acceptable supported boundary?
rationale: The report's suggested fix affects how a gateway authentication secret or equivalent credential reaches browser JavaScript, which cannot be safely selected without confirming intended authentication and threat-model ownership.

options.title: Reuse the existing browser auth path
options.body: Confirm the current authenticated Control UI request contract and extend assistant-media fetches through that path without adding a new bootstrap secret field.

options.title: Approve a dedicated scoped media credential
options.body: Introduce a narrowly scoped, documented credential only if existing browser authentication cannot authorize the endpoint safely.

recommendation.title: Reuse the existing browser auth path
recommendation.body: Confirm the current authenticated Control UI request contract and extend assistant-media fetches through that path without adding a new bootstrap secret field.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter supplied the current failure analysis, but a Control UI or gateway-auth history owner should be added after direct provenance inspection.
